title: The Door
caption: your mom said don't open the door. part 1 #horrorstory #scary #animation #pov

lines.say: Your mom texts you at nine forty-seven. [pause] Working late. Don't open the door. For anyone.
lines.text: Your mom texts you at 9:47. Working late. Don't open the door. For anyone.
lines.bubble: working late. don't open the door for anyone

lines.say: The house is quiet. You're alone. [pause] Then someone knocks.
lines.text: The house is quiet. You're alone. Then someone knocks.

lines.say: Two knocks. Slow. [pause] Exactly how she always knocks.
lines.text: Two knocks. Slow. Exactly how she always knocks.

lines.say: Then her voice. [whispering] Honey, it's me. I forgot my keys.
lines.text: Then her voice. |Honey, it's me. I forgot my keys.

lines.say: You check your phone. Mom is typing.
lines.text: You check your phone. Mom is typing.

lines.say: It's wearing her coat. But it's too tall. [pause] Its head is bent against the porch ceiling.
lines.text: It's wearing her coat. But it's too tall. Its head is bent against the porch ceiling.

lines.say: It knocks again. [pause] A second time.
lines.text: It knocks again. A second time.

lines.say: And it says... [whispering] I know you're looking.

lines.say: Part one. [pause] Do you hide, or do you run out the back door? Comment hide, or run.
